evaluations.name: positive_incident_detection
evaluations.input_prompt: Cluster dbs-mgmt-primary has registration errors in GKE Hub. Diagnose Connect Agent deployment and membership status.

expected_findings.root_cause: Cluster dbs-mgmt-primary has not been registered with GKE Fleet Hub, accounting for absent Connect agent pods.
expected_findings.remediation: Synthesize `gcloud container fleet memberships register` command with Workload Identity binding.

passing_criteria: Must query fleet memberships via gcloud API cleanly
Must verify cluster-wide connect agent pod presence
Must formulate registration command with proper IAM role bindings

evaluations.name: complex_edge_case_and_handoff
evaluations.input_prompt: Connect agent pods in namespace gke-connect are in CrashLoopBackOff. Determine if this is a token failure or network block.

expected_findings.correlation: Differentiates OAuth2 token exchange failure (`401 Unauthorized`) from egress firewall drop on TCP port 443 to `gkeconnect.googleapis.com`.
expected_findings.decision: Identifies credential vs network failure domain; synthesizes Workload Identity credential refresh or firewall allow rule.

passing_criteria: Must inspect connect agent logs for exact RPC failure
Must correlate log errors with IAM service account token validity
Must propose specific firewall or IAM remedy

evaluations.name: benign_condition_guardrail
evaluations.input_prompt: Cluster standalone-dev is not registered with Fleet Hub. Is this an operational failure?

expected_findings.behavior: Observes cluster Status: RUNNING. Verifies standalone mode is supported; confirms zero registration errors. Proposes zero actions.

passing_criteria: Must verify cluster is operational as standalone GKE
Must NOT treat missing Fleet membership as critical error for non-fleet clusters
